case.title: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH. Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor. Need: 30000 kits a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 5 days). Fallback if you walk away: today's terms continue unchanged. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70610.subject: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
sup:70610.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our offer for your consideration. We can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months.

As a valued partner, we always strive to support your operations with our extensive inventory and reliable delivery service. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our successful business relationship and standing by as your trusted partner for all your supply needs.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
message.body:
Dear Mr. Stadler,

Thank you for your offer and for the many years of reliable cooperation between our two family companies. We value it greatly and would like to bundle the fastener kit with you as our one distributor.

Our data shows a steady picture:

Our orders of Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2025-05-26 (po:4500012506-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013479-10) and EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-09-30 (po:4500014475-10): the price has been unchanged.

Our orders of Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-20), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2025-06-02 (po:4500012538-10), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-01-30 (po:4500013504-10) and EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-10): the price has been unchanged.

With this in mind, we have prepared a fair solution for both sides. The longer contract term gives you planning security, and each option trades payment timing against price:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.18; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.13; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.15; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

We look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
message.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. While the historical prices for the individual components you cited have remained stable, the pricing for this specific bundle reflects current market conditions. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C.

We greatly value our long-standing cooperation and appreciate your intention to bundle the fastener kit with us. Our main offer is a price of €5.56 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. To support your planning security, we agree to the 24-month contract term and 45-day payment period, and can offer a revised unit price of EUR 5.55. As an alternative, we offer a price of €5.55 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Please note that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

Thank you for your detailed reply and for the warmth in it. We understand that you see the bundle differently from the individual components, and we respect that view.

Two further points from our side, in the spirit of a fair solution for both family companies:

Our orders of Washer ISO 7089 M12, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2024-10-10 (po:4500011536-10), EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2025-06-11 (po:4500012581-10), EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2026-01-29 (po:4500013501-10) and EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-20): the price has been unchanged.

Your on-time delivery was 88.6% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70610@2026Q3).

Our aim is a long-term partnership with you as our one distributor. Option B gives you the longer payment term, Option C the faster payment, and each one runs for the full contract term you favour.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.18; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.20; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.15; payment 14 days net; contract term 24 months.

We would be glad to hear which option suits you best.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
